title: Colts QB Daniel Jones declares himself ready for training camp after recovering from season-ending injury

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts QB Daniel Jones declares himself ready for training camp after recovering from season-ending injury
sources.description: The Colts quarterback said he expects to participate in full-team drills when training camp opens Wednesday, marking a rapid recovery from the Achilles tear that ended his 2025 season
